business_problem: Waymark needed a better way to help customers write effective video scripts because many users struggled with what to say, existing rules-based templates were too generic, and manual editing created friction that hurt campaign creation.
solution_summary: Waymark fine-tuned GPT-3 to turn raw business context into custom marketing scripts that fit its video-ad creation platform. Before the change, customers had access to templates and an earlier proprietary script-writing feature, but many still had to spend too much time editing vague copy or abandon the workflow altogether. With the new setup, information about a business and its online footprint flows into fine-tuned GPT-3 models that generate original scripts tailored to that company, which then feed directly into Waymark's existing commercial-production experience. The result is a shift from a do-it-yourself workflow toward a done-for-you model where AI handles the hardest creative drafting step and users move faster into final video assembly. That architecture makes script writing a built-in AI service inside the product instead of a separate copywriting task, so more customers can launch stronger ads with less effort.
